#### 1. autosomal recessive congenital ichthyosis 5  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.366)

**Proposed mechanism:** CYP4F22 (HGNC:24573) —DISRUPTS→ Arachidonic acid metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1908887); Arachidonic acid metabolism (REACT:R-HSA-1908887) —DECREASES→ 12-hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acid (12-HETE) (CHEBI:144019); 12-hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acid (12-HETE) (CHEBI:144019) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal epidermal barrier (HP:0001065); 12-hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acid (12-HETE) (CHEBI:144019) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital ichthyosis (HP:0000958).
